subject: Room Change Notice - $module_code
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is to inform you that there has been a room change for the following session:

Module: $module_code
Day: $day
Time: $start_time - $end_time

Old Room: $old_room
New Room: $new_room

Please make note of this change and proceed to the new room for your scheduled session.

If you have any questions, please contact the academic office.

Best regards,
University Scheduling System
